"use client";

import { Badge, Stack, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { colorPalettes } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/chakra/upstream/lib/color-palettes"

export const BadgeWithColors = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="2" align="flex-start">
      {colorPalettes.map((colorPalette) => (
        <Stack
          align="center"
          key={colorPalette}
          direction="row"
          gap="10"
          px="4"
          width="full"
        >
          <Text minW="8ch">{colorPalette}</Text>
          <Badge colorPalette={colorPalette} variant="solid">
            New
          </Badge>
          <Badge colorPalette={colorPalette} variant="outline">
            New
          </Badge>
          <Badge colorPalette={colorPalette} variant="subtle">
            New
          </Badge>
          <Badge colorPalette={colorPalette} variant="surface">
            New
          </Badge>
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Badge, Stack } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { HiAtSymbol, HiStar } from "react-icons/hi"

export const BadgeWithIcon = () => {
  return (
    <Stack align="flex-start">
      <Badge variant="solid" colorPalette="blue">
        <HiStar />
        New
      </Badge>
      <Badge variant="solid" colorPalette="green">
        New
        <HiAtSymbol />
      </Badge>
    </Stack>
  )
}

# Chakra UI badge

9 published Chakra UI badge examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
